stock splits can encourage smaller investors to invest. A smaller initial investment allows people to get into a stock when the price would otherwise be prohibitive. It can also allow an investor who only has a few shares but wants to maintain his position to sell some now that there is increased liquidity and he can sell say 1/2 his position without closing out his entire investment.

it doesn't increase a companies value, but it allows room to maneuver for smaller investors who may not have had it otherwise.
